name: Entrata
positioning: A single-stack multifamily operating system — the accounting ledger and the leasing website are the same product, not an integration.
description: Entrata is a multifamily-focused platform combining property accounting, leasing and marketing websites, resident portals, utility billing, insurance, revenue management and an AI leasing agent. Its architectural claim is one database behind every module rather than a suite assembled by acquisition.
real_estate_use: Large apartment operators use it to run a lease-up and a stabilised asset on the same ledger. A prospect finds the community site, is answered by the AI leasing agent at midnight, tours, applies and signs — and the rent, concessions and renewal pricing all post to the same accounting without a nightly file transfer between systems.
features: Property accounting and general ledger for multifamily
Marketing websites and ILS syndication per community
AI leasing agent handling prospect enquiries and tour scheduling
Resident portal with payments, renewals and service requests
Utility billing, insurance and ancillary revenue modules

use_cases.job: Operate a large apartment portfolio with leasing, pricing and accounting on one database
Compare asset performance across a portfolio without reconciling systems

capabilities: AI leasing agent for enquiries and tours
